products.name: Moveworks
products.note: Employee support automation; IT service desk agent; enterprise-grade access controls

profile_text.body:
Moveworks describes itself as an AI assistant platform designed to help workforces find answers and automate tasks across business applications. The platform operates in over 100 languages and connects to more than 50 systems, including Slack, OneDrive, Google Drive, SharePoint, Confluence, and Outlook. Employees can access the platform through chat, web, intranet, portals, and mobile interfaces, and the company says it delivers value without requiring model tuning, prompt chaining, or advanced engineering.

The core technology is the Moveworks Reasoning Engine, which the company describes as an agentic AI system that orchestrates large language models and built-in tools to understand, plan, execute, and adapt to requests autonomously. The platform offers hundreds of plugins and connectors, low-code and vibe-code tool builders, and analytics for platform management. Moveworks has also announced an integration with ServiceNow, positioning the combined offering as a unified interface for IT, HR, and procurement workflows. Gartner named Moveworks a Challenger in its 2025 Magic Quadrant for Artificial Intelligence Applications in IT Service Management.

The site's held facts list Moveworks as a single tracked product in the enterprise AI platforms and agent orchestration category, with noted capabilities in employee support automation, IT service desk functions, and enterprise-grade access controls. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are recorded for the company.
